summary: Pushes a3 bytes from the source buffer a2 into a 4096-byte ring buffer that starts at this. The write position is (head + tail) mod 4096, where head is the signed 16-bit value at this+0x1000 and tail is the unsigned 16-bit value at this+0x1002. Guard: if tail + a3 exceeds 4096 the write is rejected and 0 is returned. Otherwise the bytes are copied one at a time with modulo-4096 wrap, tail at this+0x1002 is incremented by a3, and 1 is returned.

local_names.v6: source base offset (a2 - v5) so v6 + v5 addresses the next source byte
local_names.v9: source byte copied into the ring
